primary_experiment: Three eligible R31 rate460 TASE_RNN_MATURE A units completed full 60 s Figure-eight PATHs; formal MAEs 1.282720, 1.006797 and 1.017505 N (mean 1.102341 N, sample SD 0.156304 N). Both complete TASE_QP attempts still fail the frozen actual_qd correlation gate (0.840132, 0.848607 versus 0.900). Exact frozen-input replay reconstructed all 29,956 matched-QP commands and all 513 post-solve slew rows, but does not establish physical root cause. QP MAE remains diagnostic only. Robot was already powered; the 17:55 read-only preflight confirms stopped approved joint Home and no writer after A3.
